subject: Decision Making
title: Information Cascades
description: A quick, practical guide to Information Cascades.

hook.text: An information cascade starts when people ignore their own information and copy what others chose. Logic breaks down.

buildup.text: If the first two people pick restaurant A, the third person follows even if their own information says B is better.

discovery.text: Cascades can form on very little real information. Once enough people copy.

twist.text: Cascades are fragile. One piece of contradictory information can collapse them instantly.

climax.text: Cascades look like crowd wisdom but are the opposite. True wisdom requires people to use their own knowledge.

punchline.text: Copy, copy, crash. Information cascades are conformity disguised as wisdom.

quiz.question: What makes information cascades dangerous?
options: People abandon their own information and copy others, creating false consensus
